title: Beyond the Beyond
synopsis: An early North American PlayStation JRPG from Camelot, retained as a playable reference copy from the console’s first wave of role-playing releases.

catalog.originalTitle: ビヨンド ザ ビヨンド ～遥かなるカナーンへ～
catalog.mediumForm: Pressed optical disc · PlayStation retail edition

custody.physical: Complete in box: case, pressed disc, manual, and original cover insert
custody.condition: Complete in box. Light shelf wear consistent with age. Preserved as a playable reference copy.

curatorNotes:
Beyond the Beyond arrived in North America while the PlayStation was still proving that a CD-based console could carry long-form Japanese role-playing games beyond niche import channels. Camelot’s first PlayStation RPG reached Sony Computer Entertainment America’s shelves in 1996 after a 1995 Japanese release, placing it among the earliest works that taught this hardware what a multi-disc-era JRPG could look like in Western retail.

The filing is not kept because the game is widely remembered as a high point of the form. It is kept because the Original PlayStation collection needs evidence of that first wave — when SCEA published Camelot directly, when the black disc still felt new, and when the archive’s later Sony holdings had not yet begun.

This copy is preserved as a North American retail object from that opening chapter of the platform’s software library, not as a ranking against the JRPGs that followed it.
collectionNotes:
Acquired in August 2026 as part of beginning the Original PlayStation shelf beside the archive’s existing physical Sony holdings.

The retained copy is the North American PlayStation edition published by Sony Computer Entertainment America (SCUS-94702). It remains complete in box with manual and cover insert, and is kept as the reference copy for this filing.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Sony PlayStation; compatible North American PlayStation hardware
preservation.compatibility: Pressed for North American PlayStation consoles. The retained disc remains the primary access copy.
preservation.concerns: Optical-disc aging and surface damage remain the principal risks. The disc is stored upright in its original case under stable, dry conditions; printed materials remain housed with the copy.
preservation.knownRevisions: First issued in Japan as ビヨンド ザ ビヨンド ～遥かなるカナーンへ～ on November 3, 1995 (SCPS-10014). The North American localization followed on August 31, 1996 under Sony Computer Entertainment America as Beyond the Beyond (SCUS-94702).
preservation.availability: The original physical edition is out of print and circulates through the secondary market. No current digital edition replaces this reference copy.
